messages:
maria: heads-up — CI started failing on master after merge #512. integration auth_retry_spec is flaking intermittently on the ruby-3.2 matrix job. anyone seen a token refresh race recently? cc @taylor

taylor: thanks — will dig in. i've seen similar timing-sensitive flakes when backoff defaults changed. can you paste the failing log chunk?

maria: paste from CI log:```
E  Failure/Error: expect(client.generate(...)).to succeed
#<RuntimeError: Token refresh failed: 401>
/app/lib/retry.rb:42:in `rescue in request'
/app/spec/integration/auth_retry_spec.rb:27:in `block (2 levels) in <top (required)>'
```

sam: my suspicion: the test races with the refreshable token refresher thread. our sampleapp uses a global token cache without synchronization. on ruby 3.2 thread scheduling/timing seems slightly different so the race surfaces more often.

rik: fwiw CI image was bumped this week to bundler 3.3 + ruby 3.2. also found a separate shebang nit in sampleapp bin/setup pointing to /usr/bin/env ruby2.7 which will break on the new image — probably unrelated to the 401 but worth fixing so devs can reproduce locally.

taylor: proposed fix: make the token cache thread-safe (Mutex around fetch) and relax the integration test timing a bit. i can push a small patch to #513.

maria: good plan. can you also add a ruby: '3.2' job label in .github/workflows/ruby.yml so we catch this earlier?

taylor: yep. patch sketch:```ruby
def fetch_token
  @token_mutex ||= Mutex.new
  @token_mutex.synchronize do
    return @cached if @cached && !expired?
    @cached = refresh_token
  end
end
```
also bump the integration retry timeout from 2s -> 5s. should reduce flakiness without masking real failures.

sam: sgtm, i'll review and add a tiny smoke test in devex/sampleapp to surface the shebang/bundler mismatch during CI.

maria: thanks — opening PR now and assigning @sam for review. ci-bot: please trigger a rerun once PR lands?

ci-bot: ci-bot: build queued for PR #513 (ruby-sdk). jobs: unit, integration[ruby-3.2], smoke. :rocket:
